title: Adaptation of the EORTC QLQ-Breast Cancer Module for Male BC Phase III
official: Adaptation of the EORTC QLQ-Breast Cancer Module for Male BC Phase III
summary: Around 1% of all new cases of breast cancer (BC) diagnosed annually occur in men. Most research to date has focused on female breast cancer (FBC). So that is known about breast cancer in men has been mostly derived from the research and treatment of FBC. Comprehensive, prospective data about Quality of life in men treated for BC is lacking. Therefore, a validated worldwide questionnaire for male BC will be developed.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* male sex
* evidence of invasice breast cancer (any type)
* Must be able and willing to complete the questionnaires.
* Must be able to understand and speak the language in which the patient will complete the questionnaire.
* Age \> 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cognitive impairment
* Any history of other cancers
